item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 19/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be generally fine over the region. It will be cool in the morning with rather large temperature difference between day and night. With the monsoon moderating over the weekend, temperatures will rise over Guangdong. Winds will be weak and visibility will be relatively low over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. It will be rather warm during the day.
